statement: For every even m>=4, every Boolean g on the uniform m-cube with |hat(g)(T)|=2^(-m/2) for all T, and every vertex a, define h=g-2g(a)1_{z=a} and F(z,+1)=g(z), F(z,-1)=h(z). statement: For the entire bent-splice class of ATTEMPT L4, put N=2^m and s_g(a)=#{j:g(a)!=g(a+e_j)}. Then I(F)=m/2+(m+1-2s_g(a))/N. Every s=0,...,m is attained by a character twist of the canonical quadratic base flipped at zero. Spectral entropy is the fixed E_m from ATTEMPT L5, so at each fixed m, max H(F)/I(F) over this class equals E_m/[m/2-(m-1)/N], attained by the full-parity twist.
proof_or_counterexample: The point flip removes each incident boundary edge or adds each incident non-boundary edge. Its direction-j contribution is (1-2*edge_boundary_indicator)/N after averaging selector restrictions. Character twists attain every local sensitivity and preserve flatness. L4 fixes entropy, so minimizing the exact influence maximizes the ratio.

remaining_gap: Only the bent-splice class is optimized; global FEI and novelty remain unverified.

statement: For g(z)=(-1)^(z1*z2+z3*z4+z1+z2+z3+z4), h=g-2*1_{z=0}, and F(z,+1)=g(z), F(z,-1)=h(z), the uniform five-bit Boolean function has I(F)=29/16 and H(F)>469/128>2 I(F). Thus C=2 is insufficient for the arbitrary-bent single-point splice class; no result from w505 is needed as a premise of this counterexample.
assumptions: uniform product input on four base bits and one selector
proof_or_counterexample: Squared Walsh masses are 10 copies of 9/256, 6 copies of 25/256, and 16 copies of 1/256. Lower-bound their logarithms by 4, 3, and exactly 8 respectively; edge counting gives I=29/16. All inequalities needed to refute C=2 are exact, not numerical entropy certification.
independent_reviewer: w509; analytical KEEP, response-side model evidence UNKNOWN
remaining_gap: Only C=2 for the broader bent-splice class is refuted; canonical C=2 and general FEI are untouched.

statement: For every Boolean f on the uniform n-cube and A subset [n], H(chi_A f)=H(f) and I(chi_A f)=I(f)+|A|-2sum_{i in A} I_i(f). If i is outside A then I_i and the restriction entropy increment Delta_i are unchanged.
proof_or_counterexample: Character multiplication translates the Walsh index by symmetric difference with A. Entropy is invariant under a permutation; influence follows from |S symmetric_difference A|=|S|+|A|-2|S intersect A|. The outside coordinate and the two child entropies are likewise unchanged.
